fafnir_v1.name: HOARD_PROTOCOL
fafnir_v1.description: At the end of your turn, store unused Energy as Energized. At the start of your next turn, take 1% Max HP damage per hoarded point (min 1) as the hoard is cashed in.

fafnir_v2.name: CORRUPTED_GOLD_OS
fafnir_v2.description: At the start of Fafnir's turn, he gains 2 Strengthened for each different debuff on him, then each of those debuffs loses 1 stack.

do.text: {owner}'s CORRUPTED_GOLD_OS turns the rot to gold!

fenrir_v1.name: UNBOUND_KERNEL
fenrir_v1.description: Attack programs apply 2 Strengthened and deal 2% Max HP recoil damage. Allies' attacks apply 1 Strengthened to Fenrir. Fire attacks deal up to 50% more damage, scaled by how much of your max HP is missing.

do.text: {owner} pushes its core to the limit!

fenrir_v2.name: CINDER_WALL_OS
fenrir_v2.description: Whenever an ally applies the Burn status to any unit - including themselves - Fenrir gains a stack of Sharp.

kraken_v1.name: ABYSSAL_INK_SYS
kraken_v1.description: Whenever Kraken's side draws a card outside the draw phase, apply 2 Dazed to a random enemy.

kraken_v2.name: TIDAL_CRUSH_OS
kraken_v2.description: Water cards that cost 2 or more Energy deal 30% more damage.

ratatoskr_v1.name: GOSSIP_NODE
ratatoskr_v1.description: Whenever an ally plays a 0-cost program, that ally heals 2.5% of their max HP.

ratatoskr_v2.name: INSTIGATOR_OS
ratatoskr_v2.description: Whenever an ally plays a 0-cost card at an enemy, apply 1 stack of Dazed to the target.

recursion_daemon.name: RECURSION_DAEMON
recursion_daemon.description: Whenever you draw a card from an effect, heal 5 HP.

core_overclock.name: CORE_OVERCLOCK
core_overclock.description: Daemon: +1 power for every 2 Strength you hold.

cinder_armor.name: CINDER_ARMOR
cinder_armor.description: Daemon: Cards that add burn also add 1 Sharp to host.

feedback_loop.name: FEEDBACK_LOOP
feedback_loop.description: Daemon: whenever an EFFECT draws you a card, hit a random enemy for 7 power. The draw-phase refill does not count.

hoofbeat.name: HOOFBEAT_DAEMON
hoofbeat.description: Daemon: whenever you play a 0-cost card, deal 8 damage to a random enemy.

fertile_ground_daemon.name: FERTILE_GROUND
fertile_ground_daemon.description: Daemon: Draw extra card each turn.

thermal_overload.name: THERMAL_OVERLOAD
thermal_overload.description: Increase your damage by 25%. Your burns deal 50% more damage. Host takes 5 Fire damage at turn end.

echo_chamber.name: ECHO_CHAMBER_DAEMON
echo_chamber.description: Whenever you play a 0-cost card, generate a 0-cost Tattle token in your hand.

skoll_v1.name: TREACHERY_KERNEL
skoll_v1.description: Whenever an ally loses HP to an enemy, Sköll gains 1 Strength.

skoll_v2.name: EMBER_FUSE
skoll_v2.description: Each of Sköll's hits on a Burning target applies 1 more Burn.

jormungandr_v1.name: OUROBOROS_LOOP
jormungandr_v1.description: Each turn, the 5th Water card your side plays draws 1 card.

vfx.note: OUROBOROS — the loop closing on a draw

jormungandr_v2.name: TOXIN_FANG_OS
jormungandr_v2.description: Jörmungandr's venom coats his fangs: his attacks deal +4 power per Poison stack on the target.

gullinbursti_v1.name: UNSTOPPABLE_MASS
gullinbursti_v1.description: Playing a non-Attack card that applies a status primes Gullinbursti: his next Attack deals 3 additional power for each stack of Sharp he holds. Any other card spends the charge.

gullinbursti_v2.name: KINETIC_RAM_OS
gullinbursti_v2.description: Earth Attack cards deal +2.5 power per stack of Sharp Gullinbursti holds, on every hit, but the ram blunts its own edge: he takes 1 Dazed at the start of each of his turns.

hraesvelgr_v1.name: GALE_FORCE_OS
hraesvelgr_v1.description: Whenever you voluntarily discard a card from your hand, deal moderate Air damage to a random enemy.

hraesvelgr_v2.name: UPDRAFT_KERNEL
hraesvelgr_v2.description: The first time you cycle through your entire deck and shuffle your discard pile, permanently gain +1 max Energy for the rest of the battle.

sleipnir_v1.name: MOMENTUM_DRIVE
sleipnir_v1.description: Whenever you play a card that costs 0 Energy, Sleipnir gains 1 stack of Strengthened.

sleipnir_v2.name: WAR_STEED_OS
sleipnir_v2.description: Whenever Sleipnir plays an Air Attack card, generate a 0-cost Hoof Strike token card in your hand.

huldra_v1.name: ALLURE_PROXY
huldra_v1.description: Whenever an ally applies a buff to an ally, Huldra mirrors it by applying 1 stack of Weakened to a random enemy.

huldra_v2.name: BARK_SHIELD_OS
huldra_v2.description: At the end of Huldra's first turn, she raises a massive Bark Shield, and a smaller one around each ally.

ymir_v1.name: GLACIER_HEART_SYS
ymir_v1.description: At the start of Ymir's turn, it gains 4 Bark Shield.

ymir_v2.name: GLACIAL_PACE_OS
ymir_v2.description: Jötunn cannot play more than 1 card per turn, but all Ice cards deal 25% more base damage.

draugr_v1.name: PERMAFROST_WAKE
draugr_v1.description: Draugr can act while Asleep. Whenever it wakes from Asleep or is revived, it gains 1 Energized and draws a card.

do.text: {owner} stirs from the barrow! +1 Energy next turn, draw 1.

draugr_v2.name: GRAVE_CHILL_OS
draugr_v2.description: Enemies afflicted with 2 or more different negative statuses deal 20% less damage to the Draugr.

valkyrie_v1.name: VALHALLA_UPLINK
valkyrie_v1.description: At the end of Valkyrie's turn, play a random card from her discard pile for free.

valkyrie_v2.name: REBIRTH_CYCLE_OS
valkyrie_v2.description: Whenever Valkyrie's discard pile is shuffled back into her deck, she attacks a random enemy with 15 power of Light damage and heals herself with 15 power.

audhumbla_v1.name: GENESIS_FIRMWARE
audhumbla_v1.description: Whenever healing applied to Audhumbla exceeds her maximum HP, permanently increase her maximum Energy pool by 1. Once per turn.

audhumbla_v2.name: PRIMORDIAL_MILK
audhumbla_v2.description: Every heal card Audhumbla casts also grants her 3 Regen.

do.text: {owner}'s PRIMORDIAL_MILK banks the healing as Regen.

hel_v1.name: TWILIGHT_CADENCE
hel_v1.description: The element Hel casts sets her stance at the end of the action. Dark Stance: +45% damage dealt. Light Stance: -45% damage taken.

hel_v2.name: UNDERWORLD_GATEWAY
hel_v2.description: Hel's Dark spells cost 5% of her max HP per Energy of their printed cost instead of Energy. She can spend at most 25% of her max HP this way each turn.

control_v1.name: NULL_FIRMWARE
control_v1.description: No firmware. The control carries none by design - it is the power curve made playable, so anything it beats is under curve and anything that beats it is over.

nidhoggr_v1.name: ROOT_CORRUPTION
nidhoggr_v1.description: Poison afflicting Níðhöggr's enemies does not lose stacks at the end of their turn (a final single stack still fades).

nidhoggr_v2.name: BLOOD_SCENT_OS
nidhoggr_v2.description: Whenever any Mingming drops below half of its maximum HP, Nidhoggr smells blood: gain 1 Energy and draw a card. Healing above half re-arms the scent.

einherjar_standard.name: EINHERJAR_STANDARD
einherjar_standard.description: Daemon: for every other active Mingming on your side of the field, your Light attacks deal +10% damage.

driver_war_footing.name: WAR FOOTING
driver_war_footing.description: At the end of this side's turn, every member gains 1 Strengthened. From turn 4 on, 2.

driver_tidal_surge.name: TIDAL SURGE
driver_tidal_surge.description: Every 10 cards this side plays, it deals 10 power to the enemy side.

do.text: TIDAL SURGE breaks over the enemy side!

driver_root_rot.name: ROOT ROT
driver_root_rot.description: Whenever this side's card applies Poison, it applies 1 more.

riptide.name: RIPTIDE
riptide.description: Daemon: whenever an enemy plays a card, deal 8 power to it.

short_circuit.name: SHORT_CIRCUIT
short_circuit.description: Daemon: whenever an enemy draws a card outside its draw phase, deal 15 power to it.

reactive_plating.name: REACTIVE_PLATING
reactive_plating.description: Daemon: When an ally takes damage from an enemy attack, it gains 1 Sharp. Max 3 Sharp granted per turn.

scrubber.name: SCRUBBER
scrubber.description: Daemon: At the end of your turn, remove 1 Poison from each ally.

do.text: 🧹 {owner}'s SCRUBBER vents 1 Poison from the team.

drip_feed.name: DRIP_FEED
drip_feed.description: Daemon: At the end of your turn, each poisoned ally gains 1 Regen.

overclock_core.name: OVERCLOCK_CORE
overclock_core.description: Daemon (exhaust): Max Energy +1 for the rest of the battle.

short_fuse.name: SHORT_FUSE
short_fuse.description: Daemon (exhaust): an enemy that ends its turn with unspent Energy takes 10 power per point.

static_ward.name: STATIC_WARD
static_ward.description: Daemon (exhaust): whenever an enemy applies a status to your side, it takes 8 power.

ember_ward.name: EMBER_WARD
ember_ward.description: Daemon (exhaust): whenever an ally is hit by an attack, the attacker gains 1 Burn.

short_fuse+.name: SHORT_FUSE+
short_fuse+.description: Daemon (exhaust): an enemy that ends its turn with unspent Energy takes 15 power per point.

riptide+.name: RIPTIDE+
riptide+.description: Daemon (exhaust): whenever an enemy plays a card, deal 11 power to it.

short_circuit+.name: SHORT_CIRCUIT+
short_circuit+.description: Daemon (exhaust): whenever an enemy draws a card outside its draw phase, deal 20 power to it.

static_ward+.name: STATIC_WARD+
static_ward+.description: Daemon (exhaust): whenever an enemy applies a status to your side, it takes 11 power.

feedback_loop+.name: FEEDBACK_LOOP+
feedback_loop+.description: Daemon (exhaust): whenever an effect draws you a card, hit a random enemy for 10 power.

hoofbeat+.name: HOOFBEAT_DAEMON+
hoofbeat+.description: Daemon (exhaust): whenever you play a 0-cost card, deal 11 power to a random enemy.

cinder_armor+.name: CINDER_ARMOR+
cinder_armor+.description: Daemon (exhaust): cards that add Burn also add 4 Sharp to the host.

ember_ward+.name: EMBER_WARD+
ember_ward+.description: Daemon (exhaust): whenever an ally is hit by an attack, the attacker gains 4 Burn.

core_overclock+.name: CORE_OVERCLOCK+
core_overclock+.description: Daemon (exhaust): +1 power for every Strength you hold.

thermal_overload+.name: THERMAL_OVERLOAD+
thermal_overload+.description: Daemon (exhaust): your Burns deal 75% more damage. Host takes 5 Fire damage at turn end.

reactive_plating+.name: REACTIVE_PLATING+
reactive_plating+.description: Daemon (exhaust): when an ally takes damage from an enemy attack, it gains 1 Sharp. Max 5 per turn.

echo_chamber+.name: ECHO_CHAMBER_DAEMON+
echo_chamber+.description: Daemon (exhaust): whenever you play a 0-cost card, generate a 0-cost Tattle token in your hand — two the first time each turn.

driver_tenth_strike.name: TENTH STRIKE
driver_tenth_strike.description: Every 10th attack card this side plays deals 50% more damage.

driver_static_field.name: STATIC FIELD
driver_static_field.description: Every card this side plays deals 6 power to a random enemy.

driver_antivenom.name: ANTIVENOM
driver_antivenom.description: At the end of this side's turn, each poisoned member loses 1 extra Poison.

driver_overkill_recovery.name: OVERKILL RECOVERY
driver_overkill_recovery.description: Whenever an enemy faints, every living member of this side heals 8% of max HP.

driver_first_blood.name: FIRST BLOOD
driver_first_blood.description: The first attack card this side plays each turn deals 20% more damage.

driver_element_fire.name: FIRE DRIVER
driver_element_fire.description: This side's Fire attack cards deal 10% more damage.

driver_element_water.name: WATER DRIVER
driver_element_water.description: This side's Water attack cards deal 10% more damage.

driver_element_earth.name: EARTH DRIVER
driver_element_earth.description: This side's Earth attack cards deal 10% more damage.

driver_element_air.name: AIR DRIVER
driver_element_air.description: This side's Air attack cards deal 10% more damage.

driver_element_nature.name: NATURE DRIVER
driver_element_nature.description: This side's Nature attack cards deal 10% more damage.

driver_element_ice.name: ICE DRIVER
driver_element_ice.description: This side's Ice attack cards deal 10% more damage.

driver_element_light.name: LIGHT DRIVER
driver_element_light.description: This side's Light attack cards deal 10% more damage.

driver_element_dark.name: DARK DRIVER
driver_element_dark.description: This side's Dark attack cards deal 10% more damage.

driver_frayed_signal.name: FRAYED SIGNAL
driver_frayed_signal.description: At the start of your first turn, each member loses 25% of its max HP.

do.text: FRAYED SIGNAL: {owner} loses a quarter of its HP to the torn stream.

driver_static_haze.name: STATIC HAZE
driver_static_haze.description: At the start of your first turn, each member gains 2 Weakened.

do.text: STATIC HAZE: {owner} is clouded by static.

driver_bulwark_reflex.name: BULWARK REFLEX
driver_bulwark_reflex.description: The first time each member drops below 50% HP in a fight, it gains 15 Bark Shield.

driver_deep_cache.name: DEEP CACHE
driver_deep_cache.description: The first bonus (non-natural) draw this side makes each turn grants the drawer 1 Strengthened.
